name: OECD AI Principles
note: Titles and numbering follow OECD/LEGAL/0449 as revised on 3 May 2024. Statements are FairMind summaries, not OECD text; see each source_uri for the authoritative wording. Section 2 (recommendations to governments) is not included.

requirements.title: Principles for responsible stewardship of trustworthy AI
requirements.statement: Values-based principles that all AI actors should promote and implement according to their roles.

controls.title: Inclusive growth, sustainable development and well-being
controls.statement: Steer AI toward benefits for people and the planet: augment human capabilities, include underrepresented groups, reduce inequalities and protect the environment.

controls.title: Respect for the rule of law, human rights and democratic values, including fairness and privacy
controls.statement: Respect the rule of law, human rights and democratic values across the AI lifecycle, with safeguards such as human oversight and protection against misuse.

controls.title: Transparency and explainability
controls.statement: Disclose when AI is used and give meaningful, context-appropriate information about how a system works so affected people can understand and challenge its outcomes.

controls.title: Robustness, security and safety
controls.statement: Keep AI systems robust, secure and safe throughout their lifetime, assess risks continually, and be able to override, repair or decommission a system that causes harm.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.statement: Be accountable for the proper functioning of AI systems: keep traceability, apply systematic risk management across the lifecycle and follow responsible business conduct.
